name: Pinocchio (Rigid Body Dynamics Library)
description: Pinocchio is a fast and flexible C++ library for rigid body dynamics computations, widely used as a physics simulation backend for robotics research and agent evaluation. It provides high-performance kinematics and dynamics algorithms suitable for model-based control and reinforcement learning policy evaluation. Alongside MuJoCo, it is cited as a preferred simulator for control-intensive tasks requiring high-frequency, physically accurate simulation and sim-to-real benchmarking.
reputation: Widely used in robotics and embodied AI research; standard tool for model-based control and sim-to-real policy evaluation.
notes: Not a benchmark in the traditional sense but a simulation substrate used to evaluate embodied agents. Preferred for model-based control over MuJoCo in some settings due to its rigid body dynamics accuracy and speed. Used in AI 3.0 robotics pipelines.
